blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Risa Hontiveros has filed a proposed bill that seeks to recognize, prevent, and penalize violence against women in politics, including the more alarming online and technology-facilitated abuse. Hontiveros filed proposed Senate Bill No. 2567 on Tuesday, a day after the Chinese Embassy Manila responded to her resolution urging President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to declare Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan persona non grata or request the Chinese government to recall him.
